Welcome! I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the Pennsylvania State University. I am advised by Prof. Patrick McDaniel and am lead graduate student of the Systems and Internet Infrastructure Security Laboratory (SIIS).

My research focuses on the security of machine learning systems and using machine learning for security. I am exploring how machine learning systems can be abused by adversaries and techniques to better secure them. I am also investigating how to leverage machine learning to solve challenging security problems.
